model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents the distribution of data across two nested categorical variables: “Ambiguity Std” (outer ring) and “Max Ambiguity” (inner ring). The outer ring is divided into four segments, colored in varying shades of blue, corresponding to standard deviation levels of 0.0 (49.0%), 0.47 (47.7%), 0.82 (7.0%), and 0.94 (5.0%). The inner ring, also segmented into four parts with lighter blue shades, reflects the maximum ambiguity levels: Max: 1 (38.0%), Max: 2 (39.0%), Max: 3 (14.2%), and an unlabeled segment (likely representing another category) at 47.7%. Percentages are displayed directly on each segment, and a legend to the right clarifies the color coding for both the outer and inner rings, enabling comparison of how maximum ambiguity levels are distributed within each standard deviation group.
